avis.titre: It works, but could smell better
avis.texte: I'm just starting to become more educated on skincare regimens and I tried Versed out because it seemed super accessible to a beginner. I really appreciate the product description and clear instructions on the actual bottle. The cleanser seems to work pretty well, and I've been getting less acne since starting to use it twice a day, which is great! My 2 major critiques though is that I wish it smelled better (it has a pretty pungent chemically-smell) and the pump is a little weird. I have a hard time dispensing the same amount every time because the pump doesn't go just straight down - it's kind of wobbly, and can be pushed down from multiple angles, which as other reviews have mentioned, makes it hard to control how much comes out. Overall, good product at a great price, great packaging, but considering it's a facial product, the weird smell brings it down for me a bit.

At first experience of this product, it was not my favorite due to 2 reasons: 1) The fragrance and 2) The pump. The fragrance is not very pleasant, it's not horrible and is pretty tolerable I just wish it had more of a refreshing scent instead of the typical "non-fragrance" smell. The pump is actually really unique but I wish it dispersed less product than it does. Not much product is needed to get a rich lather and with this kind of pump it's easy to over use product. I do however really enjoy the how my face feels after a cleanse, not too stripped and it definitely offers anti-oxidation because I noticed when used this my dark spots from my breakouts lifted a lot faster than usual. Would recommend as a daily cleanser am and pm, especially to those struggling with dark spots, hyperpigmentation and early aging. **This review was created through an educational promotional event hosted between the brand and beauty experts.**

Versed products tend to be mostly hit or miss for me, with most landing on the "hit" side. I'm pretty loyal to my favorite cleanser as far as repurchasing, but I often try different cleansers as a very curious, product loving licensed esthetician. As for The Purist Antioxidant Cleanser, it lands somewhere in the middle. I like it but don't have any strong feelings towards it. I like the minimalist packaging and pretty blue color. I like how gentle it is and that it doesn't dry out my skin. I like the boost of antioxidants, although my products that stay on my skin are packed full and do the heavy lifting in that department. It's a good cleanser for any skin type, even if your skin is sensitive. As for dislikes, I really don't have any - other than it being basic. I won't replace my usual cleanser with it, but I'll continue to use this one in the morning for now. **This review was created through an educational promotional event hosted between the brand and beauty experts.**

Versed The Purist Antioxidant Cleanser is a skin care cleanser that I put to the test. I wanted to see if this product would actually clean my skin from all oils and makeup without having to do a double cleanse. I typically do a double cleanse but I wanted to see what this cleanser could do.I will be honest, I did not expect it to clean my face the way it did. When I grabbed my cotton pad and some toner to go in after cleansing my face, I fully expected to see makeup on that cotton pad. There was none. Not one drop of foundation came up on that cotton padMost cleansers require a double cleanse, or to use a sister product after breaking down the make up. The only area that needed a little extra love was to remove my mascara, and even that was.From my experience, Versed delivers every time! This product cleaned my face quickly and efficiently, as well as having ingredients, such as B12 and aloe to protect and hydrate. I was able to wash my face without stripping the skin and leaving it taut. **This review was created through an educational promotional event hosted between the brand and beauty experts.**

Cleansers formulated with antioxidants are the perfect way to remove excess oil, dead skin cells and sebum from skin's surface to reveal a brighter complexion. This gentle, soap-free, gel cleanser is formulated with aloe leaf juice, blueberry, raspberry, apple and cucumber fruit extracts. Antioxidants help protect skin cells from damage and aging and may improve skin texture and appearance. The Purist Antioxidant Cleanser from Versed comes in a very nice blueish plastic bottle topped with a pump dispenser. The packaging is very pretty, with a very light scent, the cleanser has a light gel formulation that creates a nice lather. I have used this cleanser as a first cleanser in my double cleanse routines. The reason is some stubborn makeup does not come fully off with this cleanser, so I use a second cleanser in those situations. Overall, this is a good product to keep your face clean from dirt and impurities. **This review was created through an educational promotional event hosted between the brand and beauty experts.**

As someone who works in the beauty industry taking care of my sensitive skin is a high priority. Finding the right cleanser for my skin type and routine can be a daunting task. That's why I was super excited to try Versed The Purist Antioxidant Cleanser with its soap and fragrance free formula. I loved the packaging at first sight. It's the perfect size with an easy to dispense pump and made with recyclable material. It's a beautiful light blue color that's also sheer so you can easily see when the product will start to run low. The product itself very easily emulsified into a sudsy lather when added to wet hands or cloth. There is very minimal fragrance present and what is able to be smelt is light and clean. The cleanser is very gentle on the skins surface leaving it feeling clean, but not dehydrated after use. I did find it difficult to remove makeup with this cleanser alone when I wore a fuller face for the day. Overall this was a fantastic product for my sensitive skin and I would recommend it to anyone looking for a new face wash. **This review was created through an educational promotional event hosted between the brand and beauty experts.**

Versed The Purist Antioxidant Cleanser is such an amazing cleanser. The Purist is a fragrance-free, soap-free gel cleanser. It is gentle on your skin, not harsh at all. Let's not forget about the wonderful antioxidant blend of blueberry, raspberry, apple, and cucumber extracts that help soften and cleanse your skin. **This review was created through an educational promotional event hosted between the brand and beauty experts.**

As a licensed esthetician and certified medical esthetician, I have a lot of clients who see me for advanced treatments such as chemical peels, dermaplaning, laser, microneedling, etc. I am always looking for great, gentle, nourishing cleansers to recommend for post-treatment aftercare that are safe for all skin-types. I just recently tried the Purist Antioxidant Cleanser by Versed and it was everything I had hoped it would be and MORE! I love pretty much everything Versed has ever put out and The Purist is no exception! This cleanser is gentle, fragrance-free, and soap-free, and still delivers amazing results! The first time I used this cleanser my skin felt squeaky clean and gorgeous, and my skin did not feel stripped or depleted whatsoever. My skin looked instantly fresh and glowy, and I swear my pores looked smaller after only one use! I continued to use this cleanser everyday for two weeks and it seemed to have helped with some of my skin redness, and I think I am also less congested overall. I also used this cleanser for one week straight following a chemical peel, and my skin seemed to heal faster than with other cleansers I have used in the past. I would recommend this cleanser to literally anyone, but especially to those who have a sensitized/damaged skin-barrier, or for those who are prone to acne, as soap-free cleansers will not irritate skin that is already inflamed. **This review was created through an educational promotional event hosted between the brand and be

The cleanser worked really well on my oily skin and reimbursed the extra hydration for a bright and glowing skin complexion that's completely affordable plus perfect for sensitive skin. **This review was created through an educational promotional event hosted between the brand and beauty experts.**

avis.titre: Another cleanser that's worth the mention
avis.texte: As a licensed esthetician I have always wanted to be able to recommend products that work regardless of its price point. With that being said, products that are super affordable yet effective are the best ones. When it comes to choosing a cleansers, believe it or not it matters what type you go for even if it's a wash off product. I love that Versed focuses on creating products that are great for all skin types, just like they did with this cleanser. It's formulated to remove all dirt and impurities while hydrating the skin and protecting its barrier, as well as calming and soothing the skin. The gel feels really nice on the skin as well. A little goes a long way. It's fragrance free, which personally I don't mind fragrance but again, really nice of Versed to consider that. The packaging is aesthetically pleasing. I recommend it! **This review was created through an educational promotional event hosted between the brand and beauty experts.**

Well, this is a first for me. I have been in this industry for over 27 years, as a Medical Aesthetician, Makeup Artist, and Beauty Expert. First off, having the knowledge to the "why" behind skincare or makeup ingredients can significantly help with product selection when taking your skin's sensitivities and trends of recurring irritation or negative experiences that can be avoided, into consideration.Most "calming" formulas for sensitive skin do an excellent job of reducing redness and fortifying the skin's barrier cells to strengthen skin and make it less reactive. Wonderful for a temporary fix until you want to address issues with certain active ingredients. But products have gotten way too complicated with literal warnings of side effects, and intense fragrances. What Versed The Purist Antioxidant Cleanser does, is become one of the only cleansers that not only has a gentle, calming effect with zero fragrance, but we get an added bonus of active ingredients such as brightening Bitamin C and hydrating hyaluronic acid and glycerin. All presented in this simple, clean, beautiful formula. Brilliant! **This review was created through an educational promotional event hosted between the brand and beauty experts.**

I'm a makeup artist and aesthetician, so I'm forever playing with and trying out different cosmetics. So, I like to discover cleansers that thoroughly and effectively remove everything from my face and yet leave my skin clean but not stripped. This cleanser is dispensed via a pump, so it's super convenient and easy to measure out exactly hoe much you need to lather up. My complexion is clean and perfectly prepped for my following skincare regimen after each wash. There's no scent to the cleanser, which is fine by me. I found myself reaching for this more in the evenings, as I prefer to use it as part of a double-cleanse routine. I also tend to like to use a cream cleanser in the morning, so I have reserved this foaming wash for nighttime prep. I also like the thicker viscosity of the gel, as it seems more concentrated and I don't need as much product to get worked up and washing. Versed products are very affordable and widely available, so I find myself recommending them often to friends and clients. **This review was created through an educational promotional event hosted between the brand and beauty experts.**

Hi, my name Is Kaisa, and I am a skincare lover. I am always on the hunt for a good affordable cleanser. I have tried a few Versed skincare items in the past and they do not disappoint. I love that they have clean ingredients, are affordable, and are easily accessible. I am not going to lie, I have never been one to invest in expensive cleansers because they are on and off so quickly, that I didn't see the importance. I absolutely love this cleanser. It cleans my skin as well as some of my most expensive products but is one of the more affordable products that I own. Not only is it an amazing product, I love how easy the bottle is to use. It gives out a large pump that is perfect for my face. I also want to add that it is very easy to travel with, which is important for me. This product gets very sudsy and leaves the skin feeling clean and hydrated but not tight. This cleanser has a lot of wonderful ingredients that soothe the face, so it is my go-to when in the sun all day. I would recommend this cleanser to anyone who loves skincare and is looking for a good quality, affordable cleanser. I would also recommend you check out the rest of the Versed skincare line as I have yet to be dissatisfied with one of their products. **This review was created through an educational promotional event hosted between the brand and beauty experts.**

As someone who has been in the beauty world for many years now I've gotten to opportunity to try a variety of different products. Something I am obsessed with is cleansers, I can't even put a number to how many I've tried. This one was quite nice. I appreciate how it doesn't have a fragrance because that often can be a deterrence for many, however I personally do tend to like a little fragrance. This is a gel cleanser which when you emulsify with water creates a nice lather to clean your face. I will say my face felt clean and after using didn't feel dry or parched. But as someone who has dry skin I prefer a cream cleanser because it gives that extra hydration and moisture that a gel cleanser lacks. Another down side is that I couldn't feel safe using this on my eye area so that this cleanser didn't really get used on my full face makeup days. Overall a nice cleanser and I have enjoyed using it. **This review was created through an educational promotional event hosted between the brand and beauty experts.**

As a professional makeup artist and licensed facial specialist, I've had the pleasure of trying Versed's The Purist Antioxidant Cleanser, and it truly stands out. The packaging, designed for optimal dispensing, ensures just the right amount for a thorough cleanse. What sets this cleanser apart is its ability to effectively remove impurities without stripping the skin. The result? A fresh, clean canvas without the dryness or dullness often associated with deep cleansing. It's a game-changer for maintaining a healthy, vibrant complexion. As someone with oily skin I look for gel like consistency in the cleansers I prefer using due to it cleansing yet leaving the skin still feeling hydrated. Highly recommended for anyone seeking a gentle yet powerful daily cleanser! **This review was created through an educational promotional event hosted between the brand and beauty experts.**

I have finally found the holy grail of skincare cleansers - The Purist Antioxidant Fragrance-Free Cleanser by Versed! This product has completely transformed my skincare routine and I can't stop raving about it.Firstly, let's talk about its gentle yet powerful formula. This cleanser effortlessly dissolves impurities, dirt, and makeup without stripping my skin of its natural oils. It leaves my face feeling clean, refreshed, and incredibly soft. No more tight or dry skin after cleansing!One of the standout features of this cleanser is its rich antioxidant composition. Packed with potent ingredients like Vegan and cruelty-free superfruit complex, aloe leaf juice, and pro-vitamin B5Free of parabens, pthalates, sulfates, silicones, mineral oil, and artifical fragrance. It provides exceptional protection against free radicals and environmental damage. Since I started using this cleanser, my complexion has become noticeably brighter, smoother, and more radiant. It's like giving my skin a daily dose of rejuvenation!As someone with sensitivity to fragrances, I am delighted that this cleanser is completely fragrance-free. It doesn't contain any artificial scents that can potentially irritate or cause allergies. This makes it suitable for all skin types, even those with the most delicate or reactive skin. It's a relief to finally find a cleanser that doesn't compromise on effectiveness while being gentle on my skin.The packaging of The Purist Antioxidant Fragrance-Free Cleanser is sleek

I'm an esthetician of almost thirty years and I can't count how many cleansers I've tried and used on my clients and myself. There are thousands. I've used almost the entire Versed skincare line and I've been so impressed at the quality of the products and the price points. This is a line that's accessible and affordable for almost anyone. And every skincare regimen starts with a cleanser. The Purist Antioxidant Cleanser has a feature that I love that has nothing to do with the formula itself. A pump. When you've washed your hands and are ready to cleanse your face, a pump is the way to go. Ease of use! One pump cleansed my entire face and neck. This fragrance-free gel cleanser took off all my makeup and any grime. It's an easy rinse and my skin felt cleansed and fresh. No tightness at all. I'm a big believer in toners, and no matter which one I used after cleansing with this, there was no residue on my cotton pad. This is a great cleanser for all skin types. That's a rare brag I can give to a cleanser. No cleanser stays on your skin for long, but this one excels at leaving your skin clean and hydrated. Ready for your serums, moisturizers, sunscreen, and makeup. And at the end of the day, it will take it all off to prep your face for your active night products. I'm not the only one to have fallen in love with Versed products. It's a joy to share the wealth with my family, friends, and clients. This cleanser is a must for the beginning of any skincare regimen. Bravo Versed! **

Versed's The Purist Antioxidant Cleanser isn't going to win any flashy awards but it definitely deserves a spot in your skincare routine. This soap free cleanser actually has the scent of hand soap from the 80's (reminds me of grade school for some reason) but preforms like a thorough cleanser. It does a fantastic job of getting rid of excess oil, dirt, sweat and makeup without stripping down skin. It does give you a squeaky clean feeling on your skin while still maintaining a soft, plump complexion. I love that aloe and antioxidants are the main stars in this formula, making it great for all skin types. As a 40yo woman I appreciate this cleanser's effectiveness and it's gentle approach (it worked great in AM and PM routines). As an esthetician, I love how simple this cleanser is because it makes a great base for mixing in additives during spa treatments to tailor to each clients needs. I'm sure I will be using this cleanser up to the last drop and wouldn't hesitate to recommend to anyone that's needs a true and steady cleanser to rely on. -Miranda Rice, Master Esthetician 10+ years(40 years old, combination skin, loves products that offer an experience) **This review was created through an educational promotional event hosted between the brand and beauty experts.**

I am a licensed esthetician with many years of experience within medical spa settings. I absolutely love to try out cleansers. Cleansers for your targeted skin type as well as cleansers that make a great pre-cleanse/makeup remover. Versed The Purist Antioxidant Cleanser is unique in that it is a soap-free cleanser. It is gel-based and if you work it onto your skin with water, you can actually build up a decent lather. Without stripping your skin's healthy barrier, this product gently removes dirt, oil, debris, and a little makeup. Fragrance free and holds antioxidants and aloe to calm and sooth the skin while also hydrating it. I enjoyed using this product, however, the natural smell actually bothered me. Love that a product is fragrance free, since that is the culprit of most allergic reactions. But the smell was not pleasant in my opinion. It definitely works well as a pre cleanse. Or as your first cleanse in the morning to prep your skin for your AM routine. **This review was created through an educational promotional event hosted between the brand and beauty experts.**

The Versed Antioxidant cleanser is a beautiful product, from the stunning blue packaging to the simple but elegant formulation. I love this cleanser! As someone who's been in the beauty space for over 5 years now, I've tried so many facial cleansers. This one is the perfect everyday cleanser for all skin types. I say this because it is very lightly foaming so it isn't stripping at all and it's fragrance-free. The ingredients are simple but effective, making it a really great second cleanse. I still use a makeup remover beforehand on days where I'm wearing a full face of makeup or just heavy layers of sunscreen, but it definitely takes off light faces of makeup. I've also found that I can use this on other parts of the body as well and it works perfectly for that as well. I think anyone that tries this will like it, especially since the price is so affordable for the amount of product you get. **This review was created through an educational promotional event hosted between the brand and beauty experts.**

avis.titre: I need something that can multitask
avis.texte: The Versed antioxidant cleanser has been a product. I've had my eye on. I obviously need to look at directions before using the product because I thought it was safe to use around eyes and I learned that lesson very clearly very quickly. My eyes burned so bad on the rest of my face. The product felt really creamy and went on like a gel consistency. It did a pretty good job of taking off all my make up on my face and my skin felt clean, but not tight or stripped. The only problem I have is that I like a product that can multitask and be used on eyes and face, so I don't think I will be reaching for this one as much. I can see myself using this on my face in the winter time When i need a gentle clean and don't want my skin to feel dried out . **This review was created through an educational promotional event hosted between the brand and beauty experts.**

Having worked in the beauty industry for 8 years I have used my fair share of makeup and skincare products. Usually Antioxidant Cleaners and my skin don't get a long. I have dry to combo skin. However, this is by far the best one I have used. I like how many fruit extracts they use such as blueberry, apple, cucumber…etc. It doesn't hydrate my skin as much as other cleaners do, but since it is an antioxidant cleanser that is to be expected. I still throughly enjoy this cleanser and will continue to use it as it does make my skin feel clean and not as if there's is residue still on my face after rinsing the product off. I do think this would be AMAZING for oily skin. It won't strip your skin, but it will cleanse your face and leave it ready for your next skincare step! **This review was created through an educational promotional event hosted between the brand and beauty experts.**
